plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Zmtel LTE ODU wireless device. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, memory total, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 38595).
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Zmtel LTE ODU as a 0-100 percentage (ZMTEL-ODU-MIB cpuUsageCurrent scalar). Sustained high CPU usage can indicate control-plane overload on the outdoor unit.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Zmtel LTE ODU as a 0-100 percentage (ZMTEL-ODU-MIB memUsageCurrent scalar). High memory pressure can affect LTE session handling on the outdoor unit.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Zmtel LTE ODU in bytes (ZMTEL-ODU-MIB memTotal scalar, reported in KB and converted to bytes at collection time).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the Zmtel LTE ODU since the last restart, derived from sysUpTime. Monitoring uptime helps administrators understand device stability and identify unexpected reboots.
